subject: How to access username (not user id) to create Log Out button

messages.author: 9238886a163d0875
messages.subject: How to access username (not user id) to create Log Out button
parts: I have a private shiny app that will be accessed by multiple users.  I'd like to give them the option to Log Out.  For this I need to dynamically generate a link like https://userName.shinyapps.io/appName/__logout__ however, I'm not sure how to access the current user's userName to do this.  I know I can do session$user, but I believe this provides the user id (e.g. "bgo...@gmail.com") instead of the username (e.g. "ben").

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How to access username (not user id) to create Log Out button
parts:
Ben,

The logout url should be the URL for your app, not the currently logged in user.

Hope that helps,
-Andy
